acceptance.transfer: tvalid AND tready sampled high while rst and clear are low
acceptance.packet_completion: an accepted transfer with tlast sampled high

counter_semantics.beat_count: total accepted transfers since the most recent reset or clear
counter_semantics.packet_count: total accepted transfers with tlast high since the most recent reset or clear

transition.reset: both counters become zero regardless of all other inputs
transition.clear: both counters become zero; a simultaneous transfer is not counted
transition.accepted_transfer: beat_count increments unless saturated; packet_count increments unless saturated iff tlast is high

liveness_boundary: The monitor imposes no progress requirement on tvalid or tready. Formal Core contains only safety properties over sampled transfers.
